recipe.visualDefinition: A top-down, centered view of a translucent cobalt blue vinyl record against a stark white background. The record features fine concentric grooves and a central label area with gold-toned serif typography arranged in a balanced, symmetrical grid around a small white center spindle hole.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue record against high-contrast white negative space
Gold-toned typography centered within the inner circular label
Concentric circular textures radiating from the center spindle hole
coreInvariants: Translucent material quality with visible groove depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The record is perfectly centered, occupying approximately 90% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The small white spindle hole at the absolute center acts as the primary anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Radial movement from the center outwards, guided by the concentric grooves, then returning to the central text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform white space surrounding the circular object, emphasizing its geometric purity.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue defines the entire subject and its internal textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white provides the background and the central spindle hole.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/yellow for the typographic elements on the label.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with varying values to represent light reflecting off the grooves.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on the central blue label

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used across different scales and weights for internal consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary classical serif authority and high contrast.
Offers sharp serifs and elegant curves suitable for the gold-on-blue aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a top-down view of a translucent cobalt blue vinyl record centered on a white background. Ensure visible concentric grooves and a flat central label area of the same blue. Include a small white hole in the exact center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add gold-toned serif text in all-caps. Place the primary title above the center hole and the artist name below it. Add smaller metadata text to the left and right of the center hole, maintaining perfect horizontal and vertical symmetry.

verificationChecks: Is the blue a vibrant cobalt hue?
Is the typography centered and gold-toned?
Are the grooves visible as concentric circles?

postGenerationChecks: Check for perfect centering of all elements.
Ensure no text overlaps the center spindle hole.
Verify the gold color contrast against the blue background.
Confirm the background is pure white without artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a single-color translucent circular object with a centered, symmetrical typographic grid using a classical serif typeface in a metallic accent color.
